rules: Establish the human world with a stable composition; visible motion must come from an actual action.
Evidence arrives decisively, attaches to what it supports, and remains stable long enough to inspect.
Only one oxide action moves at a time, and it must change the consequence of the model.
The current route is shown fairly before it is interrupted or supplemented.
A verified state may resolve once; it does not pulse forever.
Risk motion depicts the actual failed condition without alarm theater.

prohibitions: No ambient drift, idle wobble, infinite orbit, decorative pulse, or motion merely to keep a frame alive.
No generic node-map build, transition pack, repeated elastic easing, or blueprint-grid flythrough.
Do not animate a pristine vector path and add a wobble filter to simulate authored roughness.
